name: Somchai Ruangdet
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the intricate workings of remote-controlled cars as a child. This early passion led him to pursue a degree in electrical engineering, where he excelled in circuit design and control systems. He initially worked in the automotive industry, focusing on engine management systems before transitioning to Formula racing fifteen years ago. His meticulous approach to problem-solving and his ability to troubleshoot complex electronic issues quickly made him a valuable asset to several racing teams.

Somchai thrives on the challenge of optimizing the performance of the car's electronic systems, from the engine control unit to the telemetry systems. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to mentor junior engineers, fostering a collaborative environment within the team. His ambition drives him to constantly seek innovative solutions and improvements, ensuring that the team remains at the forefront of technological advancements.
